name: git-hex-createFixup
description: Create a fixup commit for a specified commit. Use with rebaseWithPlan autosquash=true to fold fixes into older commits. REQUIRES: staged changes (run 'git add' first). Do NOT use for unrelated changes - create a regular commit instead.

repoPath.description: Path to the git repository (defaults to single configured root)

commit.description: Commit hash or ref to create fixup for (required)

signCommits.description: If true, allow commit signing (may prompt/hang if pinentry is required). Default false to avoid non-interactive hangs.

success.description: True if operation succeeded, false if error

headBefore.description: HEAD commit hash before the operation

headAfter.description: HEAD commit hash after the operation

targetCommit.description: Hash of the commit this fixup targets

summary.description: Human-readable explanation of what was done

commitMessage.description: The commit's subject line (first line of commit message)

suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions for resolving the error
